CheckIt Support Pages

Choose a learning outcome

Each page supports the CheckIt practice for one learning outcome in Building Toward Calculus: a short video, a quick summary, and guess-first practice that explains the reasoning.

  • EL1: Introduction to exponentials: recognizing, writing, and evaluating exponential functions
  • EL2: Graphing exponential functions: domain, range, and horizontal asymptotes
  • EL3: Introduction to logarithms: converting between forms and evaluating
  • EL4: Graphing logarithmic functions: domain, range, and asymptotes
  • FN1: Is a relation a function?
